messages:
nora: dropping the latest keylist revamp for review. Main asks: wording for rotate vs rotate+reveal, how to show ephemeral copy, and archive vs revoke naming. mock: https://design.redwood.ai/keylist-revamp.png devin: Quick glance 1: I think 'Archive' feels less scary than 'Revoke' but could be ambiguous. Maybe 'Archive (recoverable)' label? Also, rotation flow needs to surface which services will be affected. tara: Accessibility concern: when we show the one-time secret (after rotate), screen readers need a clear announcement and the reveal button must be focusable. Don't autofocus into the secret field. liam: Frontend feasibility: we show the new key once in a modal with copy-to-clipboard + download. We can also expose a event: key.rotate.preview_shown. For keyboard, modal must trap focus and Esc should close. olga: Copy proposal for rotate modal: title 'Rotate key', body 'A new secret will be generated and shown once. Update any services before archiving the old key.' Primary CTA 'Rotate and show secret' Secondary 'Cancel'. Add a checkbox: 'I will update integrations' to warn users. nora: For archive flow: show a banner in the key row: 'Archived • recover within 14 days'. Yellow/amber tone. Permanent delete should be called 'Delete forever' and be separated into a separate menu item. devin: Agree re: 14 days. Compliance asked for audit log entry when keys are archived/deleted. We should add an inline microcopy: 'Archived by @nora on Mar 3' in details. tara: Keyboard patterns: each key row should present a single actionable item in tab order (checkbox or primary action). Overflow menu items must be reachable by arrow keys and have aria-labels like 'Archive key project-xyz (recoverable)'. liam: Implementation nuance: SSO-managed keys: disable rotate and show tooltip 'Managed by your Identity provider'. Also hide download button for managed keys. olga: Revoke vs archive wording test: A/B test copy variants: A) 'Archive (recoverable)' vs B) 'Disable (recoverable)'. Track metric: % of users who immediately delete after archiving. nora: Empty state variant: 'No keys yet' plus two CTAs: primary 'Create first API key' and secondary 'Learn about key security'. Small hint: 'Use least privilege scopes and rotate regularly.' tara: Empty state AX: add a skip link to 'Create first API key' for screen reader users and set aria-describedby to include the hint text. Also ensure buttons have descriptive aria-labels e.g., 'Create a new API key for this account'. liam: Small code example for announcing secret reveal (different pattern):
New key generated. This secret is shown only once.
We should avoid assertive unless the user explicitly triggered rotation; otherwise polite. devin: Good call. For rotate modal flow: user clicks rotate -> show checkbox -> enable CTA -> show secret panel with copy/download -> CTA 'Done' closes modal. Also include 'Revoke old key' toggle (checked by default). olga: UX nit: show an inline summary after rotate: 'Rotated 1 key. Old key archived for 14 days. New key: ****-abcd (revealed)' with an affordance to re-open the reveal. Also surface scopes next to key name as comma-separated inline text for dense rows. nora: One more: mobile layout. Overflow menu should be full-screen sheet on narrow view and actions stacked. Ensure the destructive delete sits last and is red. uxbot: designbot: uploaded revised mocks to /assets/keylist-archive-rotate-v3.png (sha256:deadbeef). liam: I'll prototype the keyboard-only flow and ensure single-tab navigation across the list. tara can validate SR strings. olga will set up copy A/B test. nora to confirm retention policy with security. Thanks all.
